bounded_slice.tested_scope: Current repository-defined o_novelty_comparator write authority only: research_comparators_clean_g1/novelty/, research_comparators_clean_g1/relevance/, and immutable automation_control/receipts/o_novelty_comparator/. No protected-primary or scheduler mutation was considered executable.
observations: A second durability domain must survive total loss or replacement of the same Git authority domain; another branch, tag, commit, tree, blob, or PR ref in the same repository does not satisfy that independence requirement.

Issue/comment-like records would be a different GitHub datastore surface, but mutation of those records is not included in this comparator's declared write namespaces, so this role cannot test or rely on them without weakening authority boundaries.
External storage/service sinks are likewise outside the role's authorized write destinations; no such route is accepted or tested here.
Therefore the prior total-domain rewind/delete-recreate residual remains unresolved. The absence of an authorized independent write surface is diagnostic evidence, not Phase-1 acceptance evidence.
